messages.subject: S4 done
messages.body: On branch fleet/build-s4 (head ec5b1f5fb0dce6391174a03b8989d6bde9844f96, not pushed) I fixed all three deviations red-first: nested link/image markup resolves innermost-first, inline HTML tags are stripped except inside code spans (which are now literal, including link/emphasis syntax), and slugs keep Unicode L*/M*/N* plus _ and -, so decomposed accents survive. TOC labels now use the same rendered text as slugs and empty-rendered headings are omitted; the full suite passes (88 tests, python3 -m unittest discover) with guard tests for each case including the code-span tag. Nothing left; ruff is not installed here so lint was not run, and I replaced one old test that asserted raw-markup labels.
